Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Punchline: MIDI workbench, Bard performance, ensemble arrangements and native concert capture.
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with an in-game MIDI Workbench: piano roll and note editing, track tools, drum splitting with custom pitch maps, C3-C6 adaptation, undo/redo, SoundFont preview and MIDI/LRC export. Includes native ensembles, Soulweaver Studio, Showmaster and the separate Windows capture engine with MP4 recording and HD preview.
